remarks: An excellent opportunity to own a Spacious & Sun filled 2-bedroom corner-unit condo in the sought-after Linden House community! This light-filled home features gleaming hardwood floors throughout and a stylishly updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, updated cabinetry, a pantry, providing plenty of storage, perfect for everyday convenience. The large dining area seamlessly opens to a spacious, sun-filled living room, picture windows overlook the beautifully manicured grounds with mature flowering trees and shrubs. Both generously sized bedrooms offer plentiful closet space, ensuring ample storage. Additional features include an extra large private assigned storage unit, and on-site laundry facilities. The well-maintained community also offers a Tot Lot for outdoor enjoyment. Conveniently located near Glenbrook Station, this home provides easy access to Stamford Downtown and a stress-free commute to New York City via Metro North or car.
